Container.Name: BorrowArr
Container.Overview: Discover movies and TV (TMDb), search indexers, send grabs to download clients, and manage your library. Single container: web UI + API.
Container.Description:
BorrowArr is a self-hosted *arr-style workflow for movies and TV. You provide indexers and download clients; BorrowArr does not host media.
**This template uses the all-in-one Docker image** (Next.js UI on 3012, API on 3013 inside one container). The UI auto-connects to the API on the same Unraid IP at port 3013 when published as below.
### First run 1. Map **Appdata** to `/app/data` (SQLite, JWT secrets). 2. Map **Media** and **Downloads** to `/media` and `/downloads` (or set paths via variables). 3. Open the WebUI, **register** the first user (admin). 4. Configure indexers and download clients. Use **host IP**, `host.docker.internal` (extra host below), or your LAN hostname for client URLs.
### Paths inside the container | Mount | Purpose | |-------|---------| | `/app/data` | Database and secrets | | `/media` | Library root → `movies/`, `tv/` | | `/downloads` | Client root → `downloads/movies/`, `downloads/tv/` |
Point qBittorrent/SABnzbd (etc.) at the same download tree.
### Ports - **3012** — Web UI (WebUI link) - **3013** — API (keep published if you use the UI from other devices)
### Optional TMDb Set `TMDB_API` and `TMDB_API_READ` from [themoviedb.org](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api) for production rate limits.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: BorrowArr API (browser uses same host as UI on this port)

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download client root (movies/ and tv/ subfolders)

Config.Name: BORROWARR_ENSURE_MEDIA_DIRS
Config.Description: Create media/download folders on startup if missing (set true on fresh install)
